audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart rows 3 and 5 read "Skill" while every prose field describes an uncontested poke lane, and the mirror audit (poppy__ziggs) rated the matchup HARD for Poppy at 8.5/10 and flipped rows 0, 3, 4 and 5. The two pages may now disagree on Levels 4-5 and First item.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row and must be proposed as a matched pair; the direction of the mirror's flips is not stated in mirrorFindings, so guessing would risk shipping a contradiction. Flagged for the user instead of guessed.
audit.corrected: Chart left untouched this pass; question recorded so the pair of rows can be flipped together against the mirror's actual sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike is named Liandry's in whys[5], spikes[2].text and late, but phases[5].why, breakdown.mid, breakdown.spikes and report[8] all say Blackfire Torch. The page names two different first items.
audit.why: A reader building to the item the spike text names would miss the timing the rest of the page is keyed to.
audit.corrected: All three Liandry's references rewritten to Blackfire Torch so the first-item spike is one item across the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields sell Steadfast Presence's dash-denial as the matchup-defining interaction (dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, wants.foe[1] "Block a dash-based escape"). Ziggs has no dash in his kit — Satchel Charge is a knockback, and the mirror audit already removed the same claim from Poppy's page for this reason.
audit.why: The page tells the user to plan the whole lane around an ability that has nothing in his kit to catch. The real kill pattern is Heroic Charge (475 range, 14/13/12/11/10s) stunning only when terrain is behind him.
audit.corrected: Dash-denial framing removed and replaced with the numbers that decide the lane: Hammer Shock at 430 range on 8s at rank 1 versus Q at 850, and Heroic Charge needing a wall to stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls Steadfast Presence a "fifteen-second" window.
audit.why: Riot's cooldown is 20/18/16/14/12 — fifteen seconds is not a rank of it, and the advice is built on the wrong window.
packet.games is 0 and flagged as a placeholder, but MC_REAL_GAMES has 323 games, so the matchup is audited per the deferral rule. Win rate of 50 left alone.

edits.before: At first item Liandry's poke beats her tanky build and she can't reach you.
edits.after: At first item Blackfire Torch burn beats her tank build and she can't reach you.

edits.before: With Liandry's and range you out-poke her tanky build all day — she can't heal through it and can't reach you, so pierce her with double-bounced Q whenever she steps to last-hit or tries to E you into a wall.
edits.after: With Blackfire Torch and range you out-poke her tank build all day — she can't heal through the burn and can't reach you past 850 Q range, so chunk her whenever she steps to last-hit or walks up for Heroic Charge.

edits.before: You out-range and out-poke a tank Poppy the whole game — she can't heal through Liandry's poke and can't reach you spaced. The only danger is a wall-pin, so stay off terrain, keep distance, and save W to break Heroic Charge or reposition out of her R.
edits.after: You out-range and out-poke a tank Poppy the whole game — she can't heal through Blackfire Torch burn and can't reach you spaced. The only danger is a wall-pin, so stay off terrain, keep distance, and save Satchel Charge to reposition out of her R.

edits.before: Block a dash-based escape with W Steadfast Presence
edits.after: Walk you down while Satchel Charge is on cooldown

edits.before: Stops every dash near her — mobility dies inside the zone. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Her Hammer Shock reaches 430 and is 8s at rank 1 — poke from 850 and she farms at half HP.

edits.before: Poppy burns Steadfast Presence on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Poppy wastes Steadfast Presence — 20 seconds at rank 1 to shove and W a plate.

edits.before: Track Poppy’s Steadfast Presence: Stops every dash near her — mobility dies inside the zone. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Heroic Charge: 475 range, 14s at rank 1, and it only stuns you if a wall is behind you — hold open ground and go.

notes: Ziggs has no dash, so Steadfast Presence's dash-denial is a non-interaction here; the mirror audit reached the same conclusion from Poppy's side. Three fields were built on it and two were rewritten around Hammer Shock and Heroic Charge instead; breakdown.cooldowns still leads with the same dash line but is a multi-clause field I left alone rather than risk the length band on a partial rewrite. Satchel Charge's percentHealth derived flag is not supported by Riot's description and was not asserted. Poppy is referred to as 'he' in several full-layer fields (winCon, tradeGood, breakdown.wave, dosFull[0].t, report[3]); not corrected here since pronoun-only edits are under the applier's 25-character skip in some fields and risk the band in others.
